notes.title: Free update and discount coming today!
notes.content:
[b]Create and Share with the Editor Mode [/b]
In addition to new puzzles, players can now take advantage of the editor mode. This powerful tool allows players to design their own puzzles, share them with the Linkito community, and explore over 500 user-generated levels already available. The editor mode offers players the opportunity to unleash their creativity and contribute to a growing library of unique challenges expanding the experience further after completing the single-player mode.

[b]Innovative Real-World Connectivity[/b] 

The integration with real-world technology is one of the unique features that Linkito has to offer. Linkito supports connections with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, OSC, Twitch and more allowing players to create interactive experiences that bridge the digital and physical worlds. This feature opens up exciting new possibilities for personalized and immersive gameplay, such as making real-world puzzles, escape games, or even mini-games.

Challenge your brainpower with 15 new mathematical levels. Will you manage to crunch the numbers ?

notes.title: Linkito joins Tiny Teams 2024!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that [b]Linkito is taking part in the Tiny Teams Festival[/b], which celebrates games made by solo developers and micro-studios. From August 8th to 15th, you can [b]discover Linkito's demo[/b] and take a look at what's [i]really[/i] happening at Albatross Technologies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43689784/d3eb1a0c579e5621e0e0eda98230e9e70a1d43c6.png[/img]

This puzzle game, where everything is about connexions, will lead you through a complete narrative campaign. Link, build, solve, defuse, and decode by using your logic. Craft your own challenges in the level editor or tackle community creations. Unleash your brainpower in Linkito and ignite the insurgency!

Create unique puzzles with the level editor or unlock unlimited content and challenges for the community. Go beyond classic level design with your own adventures, narratives, or interactive sandbox creations.

It's time to uncover the truth... [b][url=https://bit.ly/Linkito]Download Linkito's demo now![/url][/b]
